data.long_description:
Stylish 3-Bedroom Townhouse | Waterfront Living | Dubai Islands

Provident Real Estate is proud to offer this elegant 3-bedroom townhouse in the highly anticipated Dubai Islands, a premium coastal development by Nakheel.

Thoughtfully designed for modern island living, this home blends contemporary architecture with comfort and functionality—making it an excellent option for both end users and savvy investors.

Property Overview

Spanning 2608.52 sq. ft., this spacious townhouse features bright, open interiors and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. The well-planned layout enhances both privacy and social living.

3 Spacious Bedrooms
Open-plan living and dining area
Floor-to-ceiling windows with abundant natural light
Private outdoor spaces ideal for relaxation
Modern finishes throughout
Lifestyle & Community

Residents will enjoy a refined waterfront lifestyle, with access to a wide range of leisure and lifestyle amenities. Dubai Islands is set to become one of Dubai’s most vibrant coastal hubs, offering:

Pristine beaches and waterfront promenades
Luxury resorts and boutique hotels
Marinas and leisure attractions
Golf courses and outdoor activities
High-end retail and dining experiences
Prime Location

Ideally positioned for both tranquility and connectivity:

Easy access to key areas of Dubai
Close proximity to Dubai International Airport
Convenient reach to Downtown Dubai and major landmarks
Why Invest?

Prime waterfront development by Nakheel
